description: Electric car models listed on the public EV Database home page: make, model name (with battery size where listed), availability text and EV-Database detail URL. Only the models on that page are returned; specs such as range are not on the list. Related tools on this server, for a different need: auto_carfax when you need CARFAX used-car listings by body style or price ceiling; auto_carsdirect_vehicle when you need CarsDirect used-car listings near a US ZIP code: vehicle. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: auto_ev_database
